newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GAC to review Belarus developments.
newsitem.headline: GAC to review Belarus developments.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers are likely on Monday to approve the mandate of an information mission to review the situation in Belarus when they meet in Brussels at the General Affairs Council.
The mission, agreed at the last GAC on December 6, was due to try and report on the legality of a constitutional referendum held by Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko on November 24.
The referendum greatly expanded his powers, allowing him to dissolve parliament and replace it with a legislature packed with his supporters who back the drive for closer links with Russia.
Russian President Boris Yeltsin has called for a merger between the two countries -- widely interpreted as a riposte to NATO's plans to expand into eastern and central Europe.
Belarus has played down the Russian offer, stressing it was more interested in integrating the two economies rather than a political union.

EU diplomats say Yeltsin's offer was unlikely to be followed up as Russia would not want to take on the additional burden of running a state as impoverished as Belarus -- the main motivation behind public support for economic integration.
